title: Wirex One migration closes Classic X-Accounts in EEA, UK and Australia
description: Wirex's migration FAQ set 30 June 2026 as the deadline for Classic Wirex support in the EEA, UK and Australia and states that active Classic X-Accounts in those regions are closed with funds returned to the main balance as part of the Wirex One migration.
notes: Regional Classic Wirex migration event only. Do not interpret this as a global shutdown of X-Accounts; Wirex One and current Wirex materials continue to describe X-Accounts.
